# Universal Packaging Group (UPG)

> Quote-led custom cosmetic packaging sourcing and project coordination for brands in the United States and Canada.

Canonical website: https://universalpackaginggroup.com
Contact: quotes@universalpackaginggroup.com
Last reviewed: 2026-08-03
Full reference: https://universalpackaginggroup.com/llms-full.txt

## Primary focus

UPG focuses on secondary packaging for beauty and cosmetic products:

- Custom folding cartons
- Custom rigid boxes
- Custom corrugated mailer boxes
- PR and influencer kits
- Custom paperboard, pulp, or foam inserts
- Artwork, dieline, proofing, supplier, and delivery coordination

UPG is a sourcing and project-coordination company. The website does not claim that UPG owns every factory or produces every item in-house.

## Additional reviewed formats

Custom flexible pouches and paper cups may be quoted after intended-use, material, barrier, ink, documentation, quantity, and destination review. A generic material description is not evidence of regulatory or food-contact suitability.

## Planning ranges

- Rigid boxes: typically 500+ units; production planning often 15-20 business days
- Corrugated mailer boxes: typically 500+ units; production planning often 10-15 business days
- Folding cartons: typically 1,000+ units; production planning often 10-14 business days
- Flexible pouches: typically 1,000+ units; production planning often 12-18 business days
- Paper cups: typically 1,000+ units; production planning often 15-20 business days

These are planning ranges, not binding offers. Final minimums, price, production timing, freight, duties, taxes, documentation, and delivery terms are controlled by the written quote for the confirmed specification.

## Quote process

1. Submit product type, intended use, quantity, delivery country, and available specifications at https://universalpackaginggroup.com/get-a-quote
2. UPG targets an initial response within one business day
3. Structure, materials, finishes, artwork, proofing, supplier route, and delivery plan are confirmed as required
4. Production coordination starts only after the applicable written approvals
